title_en: Trying a 'Diet Zongzi' and Forgetting the Sugar 😂
caption_zh: 第一次吃減重粽，結果忘記沾糖，吃到完全沒味道的皮😂大家有吃過嗎？
caption_en: First time trying a low-cal 'diet zongzi' — forgot to dip it in sugar and ended up eating a completely flavorless skin 😂 Have you ever tried one?

caption_zh: 香菜花生冰心粽裂開的瞬間⋯裡面真的有香菜😭大家吃香菜嗎？哥說「太好了，那就是你的！」笑死🤣 #端午節 #奇葩粽子
caption_en: They cracked open a cilantro peanut ice-cream dumpling and the filling was VERY green 😭 Host immediately volunteered the cilantro-hater to eat it all 🤣

title_zh: 女團看到鏡子就停不下來😂

title_zh: 金華火腿粽大評分！只拿超小一口？
